verdict.rationale: Delaware's own pages publish concrete dollar amounts rather than routing founders to a contact form: $75 name reservation, $175 Long Form Certificate of Status, $400 annual tax for LLCs/LPs, and a $200 penalty plus 1.5% monthly interest. It also documents quarterly installment percentages and hosts filing-fee and franchise-tax calculators for stock entities. missing for 10: the base formation filing fee for a new corporation or LLC is not quoted as an amount in the evidence (it is deferred to calculators), there is no published franchise-tax rate schedule for corporations, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the amounts.
